title: LX-240 Industrial Air Compressor
key_sentences: The LX-240 is a compact, belt-driven compressor for workshops and small production lines.
It delivers 240 litres of free air per minute at 8 bar and starts reliably at low temperatures.
Free air delivery falls as the working pressure rises, as shown below.
The compressor carries a warranty of 24 months from the date of purchase.
The warranty covers defects in material and workmanship but not wear parts such as belts and valves.

rows: LX-240 compressor, 230 V, with hour meter
